paragraphs: Rabbi Yose ben Yose: Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot, chapter 3, mishnah 4; Jerusalem Talmud, end of HaMotzi Yayin. In Rabbi Yochanan’s name: Jerusalem Talmud, Gittin 1:1. In Rabbi Yitzchak ben Elazar’s name: end of Terumot, chapter 1. Rabbi Eliezer went to his student Rabbi Yose ben Yose ben Petora at Uvlin: Jerusalem Talmud, Eruvin, chapter 1. Eruvin, chapter 5, 53b: Rabbi Yose bar Asin; see Rabbi Yose bar Yasin above. When he spoke in the language of wisdom, he said, and so forth. I do not know whether it should read bar Yose or whether it is Rabbi Yose bar Yasin above. Yuchasin writes: Rabbi Yose bar Ashyan, a tanna of the baraita, spoke in the language of wisdom.
